message:
Ah, the power goes out! Instead of panicking, I like to think of it as an excuse for a little cozy adventure. 🌟 I pull out the candles, grab some blankets, and maybe even make some hot cocoa. It’s a great time to reconnect with family or dive into a good book by candlelight. If you’re wondering how to prepare for such moments, I found a really helpful resource that covers everything from safety tips to fun ideas for weathering the storm. 

Have you had a blackout that turned into a cozy night in? Share your favorite tips or tricks!
